evidence.title: DayOne and Gaw Capital break ground on Phase One of hyperscale Tokyo data center campus
evidence.excerpt: DayOne reports that DayOne and Gaw Capital broke ground on the Phase One building at the Fuchu Intelligent Park campus and identifies the building's planned IT capacity as 18 MW.
